Mildly-affected fbn3 mutants survive past this point with compromised but not fully detached endocardium; severe mutants have already died
Mature valve leaflet architecture (post-embryonic maturation continues to ~90 dpf)

key_process: Declining, developmentally-restricted expression by analogy to mammalian FBN2 pattern
